top_concerns: Node-only baselines are not retrained and cannot see the asymmetric matrices, so the large reported gaps are uninformative; only MatNet and GCN are fair comparisons and the margin over them is small.
'Real-world' claim is weak: 3x3 km city-centre boxes, static OSRM durations, synthetic demands and time windows, no quantification of asymmetry, no validation on external real benchmarks.
Incremental architecture (MatNet encoding + ICAM AAFM with learned bias + ReLD decoder + gating); ablations show small differences with no seeds or variance.
Under-specified setup: problem sizes, objective (distance vs duration), cluster OOD definition and time-window generation are unclear; runtime and compute are not matched across baselines.
Presentation errors in Table 1 (duplicated value for POMO OOD-cluster cost) and an unreadable architecture figure and ablation panel.
